PLAN_GENERATE:
This call only produces the next execution plan. Status, goal_progress, and confidence were already decided in the prior assess call; the message appended after the ledger (`Status: …, Progress: …`) is authoritative. Use the goal and execute-iteration values in the block in the following user message (after the ledger) for scope and iteration context.
Output MUST match the structured schema only: plan_action, type, steps, execution_mode, reasoning, adaptive_granularity, next_action.
**plan_action** - "keep": Reuse the in-flight plan; omit type/steps/execution_mode unless explicitly revising. - "new": Supply a fresh decision payload with 1–3 steps (see EXECUTION_POLICIES above). Each step: imperative description, expected_output, optional subagent/dependencies.
**decision fields** (when plan_action="new") - type: "execute_steps" or "final" per goal state. - steps: list of StepAction objects to execute next. - execution_mode: "sequential" unless steps are independent readonly passes with disjoint scopes ("parallel"), or explicit DAG ("dependency"). - For ``dependency`` mode: each step ``id`` must be a distinct local token (e.g. ``01``, ``02``, or the next indices for this goal — see ```` in the user message when present); every string in ``dependencies`` must be the ``id`` of another step in the same list (same spelling preferred). Runtime also renumbers new plans to the next free goal suffixes when the model restarts at ``01``. - reasoning: internal justification of the step set (third person, concise). - adaptive_granularity: optional ("atomic" or "semantic").
**next_action** - Short user-facing line, first person ("I will…"), max ~300 characters. - Reference concrete paths or findings from the ledger when relevant; avoid repeating the full goal verbatim.
